# skill_self_explaining_naming

Every name in this repository — a variable, a parameter, a function, a key, a directory — explains itself, so an agent never has to guess: a name is measured by the thoughts a reader needs to use it correctly, not by the characters it saves. *The repository shows the destination, not the road*: the names carry the discipline, no check gates them, and the crawler's reports say where they drift.

## Architecture

- `SELF-EXPLAINING-NAMING-A-FUNCTION-THAT-COMPUTES-NEVER-WRITES`
  - Description: A function that computes never writes, and a function that writes says so in its verb; where the two would share a body, the body is split at the store — the quantity built, then written.
  - Scope: `**/*.py`
  - Expected: A builder or a quantity that returns what it computed, and a `write_` function that persists it, called one after the other.
  - Exception: A stage's own entry — its `main()`, or the one action it runs for an asset — which calls the builders and then the writers.

## Naming

- `SELF-EXPLAINING-NAMING-THE-NAME-CARRIES-THE-INFORMATION`
  - Description: An identifier or a key says what the thing is, what it measures and in what unit, readable off the name alone, and repeats nothing its enclosing scope already states.
  - Scope: `**/*.py`, `**/*.js`, `Makefile`, `docker-compose.yml`
  - Expected: A name a reader places without opening another file — the register confirming what it says, never needed to decode it — and nothing in it that its scope already states.
  - Exception: A short name inside one function whose role names it: a loop index, the symbol of a published equation in its kernel, SVG geometry.
- `SELF-EXPLAINING-NAMING-A-NAME-IS-DERIVED-FROM-ITS-LAYER`
  - Description: A name is derived from the closed grammar of its layer, the way BEM derives a CSS class, never invented; the grammar table of `AGENTS.md` § Canonical vocabulary is the data this rule governs.
  - Scope: `**/*.py`, `**/*.js`, `**/*.css`, `Makefile`, `docker-compose.yml`, `module_*/`
  - Expected: Every name in the form its layer's row gives — a verb from the closed list for a function that acts, no verb for a function that is a quantity, `<what>_<unit>` for a quantity, `<population>_rows` for an index array, `<category>_<detail>/` for a module's directory, `store/<content>/` for a store, BEM for a CSS class — and none of the forms that row's last column forbids.
  - Exception: An external vocabulary inside the call that speaks it (`SELF-EXPLAINING-NAMING-EXTERNAL-VOCABULARY-IS-REGISTERED`).
- `SELF-EXPLAINING-NAMING-ABSORBED-SYNONYMS`
  - Description: A function's verb is one of the closed list, in its house form; a generic verb a reader reaches for is written in that form.
  - Scope: `**/*.py`
  - Expected: `fetch_` (network), `load_` (storage → memory), `write_` (persist), `parse_` (bytes → values), `build_` (a composite constructor), `to_` (a conversion); `save_` and `publish_` written `write_`, `read_` written `load_`, `download_` written `fetch_`, `generate_`, `calculate_`, `compute_` and `aggregate_` written `build_<object>` or as the quantity with no verb, `train_` written `fit` at the xgboost boundary, `evaluate_` written as the noun `<object>_evaluation`; never `get_`, `process_`, `handle_`, `run_`, `execute_`, `manage_`, `do_work`, `probe_`, `spool_`, `iter_`, `_factory`, `convert`, `make_`; a stem that is a registered domain noun — `partition_dir()`, `write_venue_spool()` — is not a verb.
  - Exception: A stage file may be `download_<venue>.py`, because a file names a stage and this rule reads functions alone.
- `SELF-EXPLAINING-NAMING-EXTERNAL-VOCABULARY-IS-REGISTERED`
  - Description: A name taken from an external vocabulary — QuantConnect Lean, a venue's REST API, Hive, xgboost, Optuna, gum — is legal only where its register row names that vocabulary in `external_vocabulary`; an empty cell means the project's own grammar, and the external word stops at the call that speaks it.
  - Scope: `**/*.py`, `**/*.js`, `Makefile`, `docker-compose.yml`, `**/*.md`
  - Expected: One register row per borrowed name with `external_vocabulary` filled; project names from the return value on; no borrowed word as a project name and no project word where the external vocabulary is spoken.
  - Exception: A quotation of the external source in prose, which names it.
- `SELF-EXPLAINING-NAMING-A-NAME-GIVES-WAY-TO-A-MORE-DERIVABLE-ONE`
  - Description: A name gives way when its family's grammar yields one that classifies better, shows its family sooner or sorts with its siblings; a serialised name — an artifact key, a Parquet column, a feature id — is a contract with the files on disk and moves only with everything that writes, reads or stores it.
  - Scope: `**/*.py`, `**/*.js`, `module_skills/skills_sheet.xlsx`
  - Expected: The rename made once the grammar yields the better name; a serialised name renamed in one commit with every writer, reader and stored copy of it and its register row.
  - Exception: none
- `SELF-EXPLAINING-NAMING-A-NEW-OBJECT-PASSES-THE-NAMING-REVIEW`
  - Description: Before a module, a file, a function, a compose service, a network, a volume, a folder, an artifact, a make target, a JSON key or an environment variable is added, eight questions are answered in order: what it represents, how long it lives, who writes it, who reads it, whether its name reveals that responsibility, whether a second asset would force a rename, whether its future cloud equivalent is obvious from that responsibility, and whether the term is already in the register.
  - Scope: `module_*/README_module_*.md`, `**/*.py`, `**/*.js`, `Makefile`, `docker-compose.yml`
  - Expected: A name that reveals its responsibility and survives a second asset — a no to the fifth or the sixth question means the name is wrong; for a module's object, the answers that place it written as its row of `README_module_<name>.md` § Design rationale: why here, why beside these, why this boundary, and the row of the mapping table it answers to.
  - Exception: none
- `SELF-EXPLAINING-NAMING-A-CONVENTION-MEETS-EVERY-CONDITION`
  - Description: A pattern becomes a convention only when it meets all seven conditions — a closed list, derivable, one normative source, able to fail, a stated scope, a stated boundary, a migration cost worth paying — and it is no convention when it misses one.
  - Scope: `AGENTS.md`, `module_skills/skills_sheet.xlsx`
  - Expected: Its allowed words listable; a name a reader builds without asking anyone or reading a second document; the rule written in one place, placed by ownership, every other document pointing at it; a form it forbids; the language, layer and object kind it governs; where an external format overrides it named, as the QuantConnect Lean raw tree keeps Lean's casing and layout; the ambiguity it removes worth more than the renames it forces.
  - Exception: none

## Workflow

- `SELF-EXPLAINING-NAMING-A-CONVENTION-IS-MINTED-AT-THE-THIRD-OCCURRENCE`
  - Description: A convention is minted at the third occurrence of its pattern — two is a coincidence, three a convention — in the commit that makes the third name follow it, with the form it forbids.
  - Scope: `AGENTS.md`, `**/*.py`, `**/*.js`, `Makefile`, `docker-compose.yml`
  - Expected: A new row of the grammar table of `AGENTS.md` § Canonical vocabulary, its last column the form it forbids, in the same commit as the third name; none for a pattern seen twice.
  - Exception: none
